label: Strictness separator for the box K projection, checked (inference)
rule: One explicit finite model checked by unfolding
meaning: On a two-point model where both candidates are actual roots (concrete, existing at the one self-accessing world, grounded by nothing) and only one is GOD_4, the box K node holds (witness: the GOD_4 candidate) and the classical GOD_4 root fails. The failure is located: on this model the classical root is equivalent to some candidate satisfying every other conjunct of its body and being the only actual root; the GOD_4 candidate satisfies every other conjunct, and the other candidate is a second actual root that is not GOD_4. So only the selected-root uniqueness conjunct of PerfectRootAt fails, while the box K node's IsTheOneGod (uniqueness among GOD_4 bearers) does not exclude a second, non-GOD_4 actual root. Non-degenerate in this sense: no supplied predicate is emptied so that an attribute fails. In the main model six relations are empty (InPotency, MoreIn, PriorSimply, ComponentOf, Composite, MatterForm), so immutability, maximum, firstness, remoteness, simplicity and matter/form exclusion hold vacuously at both candidates, and CausesIn is total. The failing conjunct uses ActualRoot, which both nodes contain. A restored-relation control on the same signature and Profile makes all of those relations non-empty except ComponentOf (the GOD_4 candidate more in esse than the other and simply prior to it, CausesIn only from it to the other, potency, composition and matter/form only at the other); the classical root still fails through uniqueness alone, its other conjuncts hold at the GOD_4 candidate, and maximum and firstness fail at the other. So the separation does not rest on the vacuous clauses. It replaces a draft separator that failed only by emptying HasIntellect, a free parameter the box K node does not mention. Other content differences are not model-separated here. Model-witnessed only; a statement about this formal interpretation.
